title: Wycheproof as a crypto-backend difftest dimension
description:
## Why

Project Wycheproof is edge-case test vectors for crypto primitives -- ECDSA signature malleability, RSA padding, DSA, EdDSA, key-size boundaries. That is one layer below path validation but exactly where DefaultVerifier and the SignatureVerifier backends live, and it is the natural companion to PKIX-hbzo.4 (crypto backend as a difftest dimension), since the same harness would compare backends against the same vectors.

## Availability -- VERIFIED 2026-11-27

* Repository has MOVED: github.com/C2SP/wycheproof, not github.com/google/wycheproof. HTTP 200.
* Apache-2.0. Confirmed only from third-party listings (Packagist, ecosyste.ms, a Gitee mirror); the LICENSE file URL resolves (HTTP 200) but its contents were not read. Read it before vendoring anything.
* Vectors live in testvectors/ and testvectors_v1/ as JSON.

## What

Load the ECDSA, RSA-PKCS1, RSA-PSS and EdDSA vector files as a difftest corpus and run them through each SignatureVerifier backend. Each vector carries an expected result, so unlike x509-limbo this is labelled ground truth and a disagreement is a bug rather than a divergence to classify.

## Why it may matter more than it looks

Today's pkix-path mutation sweep left sha1_digest's three mutations alive -- no test verifies an ECDSA-SHA1 signature end to end -- and the verify_signature OID dispatch arms in DefaultVerifier too. Wycheproof would cover that class of gap systematically rather than one fixture at a time.
